notes.title: Demo Patch April 2025
notes.notes:
In February, we released the Brew Demo.
The demo will be updated periodically and it will stay up until the release of the game.

In the demo, we showcased the first day of arriving at the Alchemy Academy, along with a peek at the Mechanology floor and the duel against Professor Akilah. We also had a bunch of friendship events for you to unlock in the Academy Grounds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/c1a405221a7319c37684cc8390f0211abdb6005c.png
Features 


 Introduced a new break room to the tower, the Shop!
 Added explanation cards with video to the tutorial.

Balance changes 


 Added direct impact damage to the water grenade launcher
 Increased Shield Guy's jump attack damage (5 - 12)

Sound Effects


 Added firing sounds to the air sniper when you're not at the sweet spot.
 Made a new sound for the sniper
 Removed the clap sound when reaching the sweet spot
 Added a charge sound
 Updated the Water Grenade gun sounds
 Updated the Shotgun sounds
 Added new chest sounds
 Fixed a bug with the sound location of the shield guy laser, often making it inaudible.
 Updated the Crab locomotion sounds
 Updated double jump sounds
 Updated the sounds of destructables

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/6a5830446f16f91653be53cc02ac17386eaa6e4a.png
Bug Fixes and Misc Changes 


 Made corks spawn in a more satisfying way
 Shield guy

 Set a minimum laser distance
 Fixed bug where Shield Guy Rocket indicators were invisible
 Replaced Shield Guy Rocket VFX and indicator VFX

 Removed some rough WIP features hidden in the Hub
 Disabled potion upgrade with unintended behavior (fire shotgun)
 Changed collision on enemies to work with water dash
 Fixed the fire dash upgrade
 Possibly fixed an obscure crash happening to about 1% of our players :(
 Changed the visuals of hovered buttons from darkening the button to a background glow, to make it more clear what is hovered or not.
 Fixed a possible infinite loop with a specific badge combination
 Fixed water splash spawning multiple times on the water grenade
 Removed badges from the tutorial
 Updated the basic attack VFX


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/0ab891b1cb73f296972b2d26a93d54ffbfcd1d37.png

Did you know that there are friendship events for each character in the demo? 
You must become friends with them to unlock them, but event Newt and Aster have extra events!

Thank you all for playing the demo and following the development of Brew! We cannot wait to show off more of the features we have been working on behind the scenes…

Wishlist, follow and get the demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793330/Brew/
